QuestInfo.name: [Heliseum] Securing the Center 3
QuestInfo.1: You see another type of Specter. Wipe out about #r30 Power Specters#k.
QuestInfo.2: Magnus took over Heliseum, but didn't bother with the city. He just filled it with the Specter forces. So...is Magnus inside the castle?

0.0: There's another type of Specter here. Please wipe out about #r30 Power Specters#k.

1.0: Did you defeat all the enemies? Good job! I was sorting out the situation in downtown.

yes.0: You'll understand when you see the situation, but #rHeliseum is filled with Specters#k. There was no Nova alive, and no one else in sight. I also couldn't find the leader of the Specter forces.
yes.1: It seems Magnus just filled Heliseum with Specters after taking it over. #rHe isn't even managing the city properly#k. Does that mean he's inside the castle?
yes.2: I don't know how the situation is inside the castle. My role ends here. I'm going to #rreturn to base#k and report on the downtown situation. Let's go together!
